name: web-search-stub
description: The OFFLINE web-search engine (provider id `stub`): deterministic fixtures, no network, urls on the RFC 6761 `.invalid` TLD so a fixture can never be mistaken for a fetched page; every answer is marked stub:true. It registers itself with the web-search@1 service host, so the seam is provable with no credential and no connectivity.

config.description: How many fixtures the engine returns and how it can be taken offline / made to fail (a negative-control switch for operators).

results.description: Fixtures returned when the caller names no count (max 50).

latencyMs.description: Artificial delay of a call in ms (max 5000), for exercising a slow engine.

unavailable.description: Take the engine offline: available() reports false and a call fails with web-search.provider-unavailable.

unavailableReason.description: Why it is offline (shown by `web search providers`).

failWith.description: Make a call fail with this web-search.* reason (negative control, e.g. web-search.rate-limited).
